toegepas.voor: gebruik en is dit nie meer bos nie
toegepas.na: gebruik, en is dit nie meer bos nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb (die grond word gebruik / is dit nie meer bos nie), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb (die grond word gebruik / is dit nie meer bos nie).
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and changes nothing in the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Langs so 'n pad kom meer mense in en word
toegepas.na: Langs so 'n pad trek meer mense in, en word
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'kom ... in' is vague without a place ('come in where?'); 'trek in' is the natural verb for people settling an area, and the two clauses have their own subjects, so AWS requires a comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'kom ... in' is vague about where the people come in, and the comma before 'en' is missing between two clauses with their own subjects (meer mense / nog bos).
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'trek in' is the natural verb for people settling along a new road, which is what the paragraph describes, and the AWS comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Dit is wat hierdie probleem so moeilik maak om op te los.
toegepas.na: Daarom is hierdie probleem so moeilik om op te los.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is wat ... maak' copies the English 'This is what makes'; 'Daarom is' is natural Afrikaans with the same meaning and reference to the reasons before it.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is wat ... so moeilik maak om op te los' copies the English 'This is what makes it so hard'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daarom is' is natural Afrikaans, points back to the same reasons and keeps the meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die skoonmaak' as a bare noun reads woodenly; 'skoonmaakwerk' is the natural noun for the activity.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'skoonmaakwerk' usually means cleaning chores, so it reads no better here and brings in a household sense the original does not have.

vlae.blok: Kopers ver van die woud af
vlae.teks: Die vleis en die gewasse word dikwels ver weg gekoop, in die land waar die bos gestaan het en in ander lande.
vlae.rede: 'ver weg' followed by 'in die land waar die bos gestaan het' can read as a contradiction (far away, yet in the same country); the intended sense is probably 'far from the forest', but 'ver weg gekoop' is protected, so a writer should decide whether the sentence needs a reference point such as the forest.
